title: Abba of Hagronia
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: The father of Rav Shmuel. After his death, Rabbi Abba (I) married his widow, as explained in [Bava Kamma 88a (Hyman cites 88b)](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.88a.21).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage names Rav Shmuel bar Abba of Hagronia and says his mother married Rabbi Abba.

[Heilprin’s Abba of Hagronia entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=68&lang=en) also identifies Abba as Shmuel’s father and mentions the marriage. Hyman gives the sequence after Abba’s death and designates the husband Rabbi Abba (I).
